latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Accessibility Scanner.

- Scans web applications for accessibility issues, including WCAG 2.2 compliance, screen reader compatibility, keyboard navigation, color contrast, and ARIA usage.
- Provides step-by-step audit with static code analysis, WCAG checklist (A/AA/AAA), and component-level review criteria.
- Recommends integrations with automated tools such as axe-core and eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y.
- Example audit report format highlights critical errors, warnings, and passing areas.
- Guides on manual and automated accessibility testing best practices.
